turns.question: What was the ratio of non-cancelled order revenue to total ad spend in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for a ratio of revenue to ad spend, so I cannot give that ratio; the closest metrics are Revenue (EUR) at 12582.75 EUR and Ad spend (EUR) at 6270.00 EUR, both for September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30), which can be set side by side.
